description: Use this when an owner wants their share paid to their bank and has not set it up, for example when no bank is set up yet. Confirm with the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. It returns a link to Stripe's own form, where the owner gives their bank to Stripe. It is a link only: the bank is never given in the chat, and it takes no payment. It needs a connected Phorme account.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to setting up payouts.

country.description: The two letter country of the bank, for example US. Default US.

name: get_payout_setup_link

setup_url.description: Stripe's own form, or null when it opens from the console.

title: Get my payout setup link
